# Amazon ML Challenge Explorer
> An independent leaderboard explorer, search engine, and institutional analytics platform for the Amazon ML Challenge 2026 dataset.

## Platform Overview
- Website: https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app
- Challenge Name: Amazon ML Challenge 2026
- Challenge ID: 290344
- Competition Type: CodeContest / Machine Learning
- Source Platform: Public Unstop Leaderboard Data
- Collection Scope: 114/114 complete leaderboard pages (100% complete historical snapshot)
- Dataset Dimensions:
  - 3,398 total teams & submission records
  - 11,394 individual participant profiles
  - 1,350 unique academic institutions & organizations

## Independence & Data Disclaimer
- Amazon ML Challenge Explorer is an independent data analysis and exploration tool built by researchers and participants.
- This platform is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Amazon, Unstop, or the official competition organizers.
- The leaderboard data represents a complete offline historical snapshot of the public leaderboard as finalized during the competition.
- Metrics such as college aggregates, score distributions, and cross-college team breakdowns are derived directly from the immutable dataset snapshot.

## Primary Routes & Navigation
- `/` - Main Explorer Dashboard: Universal search across teams, participant names, and colleges with quick filters.
- `/leaderboard` - Official Contest Standings: Complete 3,398-team rankings with filters by rank tier (Top 10, Top 25, Top 50, Top 100) and team size.
- `/organizations` - Institutional Directory: Alphabetical and ranked index of 1,350 participating colleges and universities.
- `/organizations/[slug]` - College Profile: Entity page showing total student teams, participant roster, best rank, score distribution, and team links for a specific university.
- `/teams/[teamId]` - Team Profile: Entity page detailing official rank, score, finish timestamp, participant names, and university affiliations.
- `/compare` - Institutional Comparison Tool: Multi-university comparison of participation volume, top ranks, and score percentiles.
- `/cross-college` - Inter-University Collaboration Directory: Catalog of multi-institution teams where participants teamed up across different universities.

## Data Interpretation Guidelines
- **Scores**: Range from 0.000000 to 1.000000 based on the official competition evaluation metric.
- **Ranks**: Ordered by score descending, with finish time as tie-breaker where applicable.
- **Affiliations**: Self-reported institutional affiliations recorded during team registration.
- **Cross-College Teams**: Teams whose members listed different academic institutions.
